validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: strongly confirmed independently. (1) Guangxi Development & Reform Commission approval notice 桂发改油气〔2022〕974号 (2022-09-12, archived: web.archive.org/web/20240521155113/.../t14899151.shtml) approves construction of '南宁-凭祥支线（南宁-崇左段）' (Nanning-Pingxiang branch, Nanning-Chongzuo section), naming the project unit as 国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司南宁输油气分公司 (matches GEM operator exactly). (2) Xinhua Guangxi (2025-06-06) reports the same-named project '试运投产成功' (trial operation/production succeeded) on 2025-06-03, first connecting Chongzuo to the national gas trunk network. (3) PipeChina (pipechina.com.cn) corporate news carries the identical completion story with matching specs. All three sources independently name the same project by its official title, which matches GEM's pipeline_name + segment_name combination closely (Nanning-Pingxiang / Nanning-Chongzuo section). CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission branch line, not a gathering/process line -- consistent across all three sources. DUPLICATE CHECK against the 43-PID roster: no other roster row uses this name. The approval doc confirms the route crosses Fusui County (扶绥县) townships, which is also the corridor for P4725 ('Fusui County->Guangxi', len=83km, dia=355.6mm, cap=0.85 bcm/y, approved per a DIFFERENT 2019-03-05 approval for a separately named '扶绥-崇左' (Fusui-Chongzuo) branch project). P4732's diameter (457mm), capacity (0.70 bcm/y), and approval date/code (2022-09, 974号) are all distinct from P4725's, so these read as two genuinely separate approved branch pipelines sharing a general corridor, not a double-count -- no duplicate flagged.

validity.recommendation: Change LengthKnown from 125.00 km to 114.76 km (as-built completion figure), or at minimum add a ResearcherNotes caveat that 125 km is the pre-construction design/approval length and 114.76 km is the as-built figure reported at commissioning.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM's own current [ref] (the 2025-06-06 Xinhua Guangxi article, currently attached to Length/Capacity/Status/Start) does NOT support LengthKnown=125.00 km -- it explicitly states '全长约114.76公里' (total length approximately 114.76 km). The identical 114.76 km figure is repeated in the PipeChina (pipechina.com.cn) corporate completion article. Tracing the discrepancy: 125 km is the PRE-CONSTRUCTION DESIGN length from the 2022-09-12 approval notice ('管道全长125公里' -- verified directly in the archived approval doc), which GEM appears to have carried forward even after the line was completed with a shorter as-built route (114.76 km, ~8.9% shorter). This is a real, material, and independently-corroborated (2 same-origin-company but separately-published) discrepancy between design and as-built length -- not a typo, both numbers are genuinely attested in different-stage official documents. Since Status=operating (post-completion), the as-built 114.76 km is the more accurate current value. Diameter (457mm) and Capacity (0.70 bcm/y = 7亿立方米/年) both check out exactly against both the design approval and the completion reporting, so this is an isolated length issue, not a broader data-quality problem with this row.
